correctness.rationale: The signed-BV derivative representation proves the all-function bound from exact single-step responses. A Beta–binomial tail count gives a two-binomial absolute-deviation equality, independently checked against direct quadrature. Factoring exact polynomials for n=1,2,3 shows strict nonattainment. Central binomial telescoping and a monotone ratio prove interior attainment at n>=4. A bounded-summand triangular-array CLT, uniform second moments including moving endpoints, and unique Gaussian limiting profile establish the limiting sharp coefficient and localization.

value.rationale: The first degree at which the sharp BV-to-L1 identity-defect norm becomes attained is a natural structural invariant for endpoint-preserving approximation. The exact two-binomial formula and the all-degree n^-1/2 sharp coefficient give reproducible discontinuity-error calibration, and the universal limiting midpoint location reveals a nontrivial boundary-to-interior mechanism absent for the ordinary integral Durrmeyer operator.
